Unicode (UTF16) APS 'name' Linking Test

Source image Reference image

Unicode (UTF16) APS 'name' Linking Test — The reference image shows a correct result of this test, upon activating the link on "456" looks like (EXCEPT that the present reference image has a small flaw (rectangular void) in the lower-left corner.) Both the "123" object and the "456" object have the same (Japanese) name. In WebCGM 2.0, it is implementation dependent whether or not a target rectangle at the edge of the VDC Extent is centered in the view window (so the vertical centering could legally vary from the reference image.)

Tests UTF16 (japanese) characters in String Fixed (SF) data, specifically screentip, name (APS Attribute), and a fragment in a 'linkuri' pointing at that 'name'.

The file does not contain non-Latin characters in any graphical text. I.e., it is not required to graphically render any Japanese characters to pass this test. It is only required to correctly handle them in the linking bits. In the metafile the Japanese graphical characters are stroked (filled polybezier).
